NNEW CONCEPT ENGLISHBOOK 01 / 新概念英语

BOOK ONE · LESSON 138

If...

如果……

A picture lesson on conditional sentences with 'if'. Six pictures show different scenarios: if it rains tomorrow (stay home / go to the seaside), if you are ill next week (see a doctor / ask a friend), if you can't make up your mind (retire / travel to England). The lesson introduces written exercises A (answer questions about the Lesson 137 dialogue), B (write 'if' sentences like the example), and C (answer questions with 'if' clauses). The workbook drills 'if' sentence completion and open-ended 'About you' writing; the grammar workbook completes 'if' dialogue items, writes 'if' sentences about the future, and chooses the correct 'if' words.

01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen to the tape and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

听录音并回答问题。

1. If it rains tomorrow, she'll stay at home. / If it rains tomorrow, she may stay at home.
2. If it's nice at the weekend, he'll go to the seaside. / If it's nice at the weekend, he may go to the seaside.
3. If you are ill next week, you'll see a doctor. / If you are ill next week, you may see a doctor.
4. If you can't make up your mind, she'll ask a friend. / If you can't make up your mind, she may ask a friend.
5. If you don't get the job, he'll retire. / If you don't get the job, he may retire.
6. If you win a lot of money, you'll travel to England. / If you win a lot of money, you may travel to England.

1. 如果明天下雨，她将待在家里。/ 如果明天下雨，她可能待在家里。 2. 如果周末天气好，他将去海边。/ 如果周末天气好，他可能去海边。 3. 如果你下周生病了，你将去看医生。/ 如果你下周生病了，你可能去看医生。 4. 如果你拿不定主意，她将问一个朋友。/ 如果你拿不定主意，她可能问一个朋友。 5. 如果你得不到那份工作，他将退休。/ 如果你得不到那份工作，他可能退休。 6. 如果你赢了大笔钱，你将去英国旅行。/ 如果你赢了大笔钱，你可能去英国旅行。
